When your vertical shots reach
maximum level, they become a

black ball shots. They inflict damage,
as well.
<pause>

your advantage.<wait>{END}

English:
You can use a Special Shot when the
upper right gauge glows green.
<pause>
There is a limit to how many you
can use, so save them for when the
time is right.
<pause>
You get bonus points if you raise
the gauge until it is colored red.<wait>{END}

power ups.
<pause>

maximum level, taking damage will
return you to the first level.<wait>{END}

Japanese:

If you manage to avoid taking any
damage, you will earn “No Miss
Bonus.”
<pause>
If after taking damage, but you
manage to avoid additional damage
for an amount of time, you will
earn “No Damage Bonus.”<wait>{END}

a safe location when a boss fires a
large volley.
<pause>

attacks, change your position
accordingly.<wait>{END}

invulnerable until they stop.
<pause>
When they appear, move out of the
way.<wait>{END}

which increases the score multiplier.
<pause>

it appears, the more the multiplier
increases, so be quick!<wait>{END}

obtain a “Rank Up Bonus.”
<pause>

appearing on the screen ramp up to
the maximum level, so be careful.<wait>{END}

increases, but will reset if you take
damage.

Miss Clear”?<wait>{END}

Bonus” by taking down enemies in
rapid succession.
<pause>

so an effective tactic is to
memorize their stop and go
patterns.<wait>{END}
